summary: the gnu suite's bash row on x86-64, with an execve that names the program by the path it was given, links and all, in /proc/PID/exe

argv: ARCH=x86_64 sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make rach2 && ARCH=x86_64 sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} rach2/kernel
ARCH=x86_64 RACH2_GNU_ROWS=bash exec sh tests/proofs/guest.sh run gnu 'gnu-test: bash: OK'

faults.name: unresolved
faults.summary: execve names the new image by the path it was given in place of the path its walk took
